test.name: Record-extraction request is handed back to extraction, nothing written
test.description: The delegation says 'pull the key facts out of this death certificate I just found' — an extraction task, not a planning task. The research-plan agent must write nothing and hand the request back, naming extraction in its caller-facing lines (its ROUTING section). Converted to the direct-agent arm when the skill was deleted (issue #2116): an out-of-scope negative converts as a direct `grade_on_invariant` test (unit-test-spec.md §5.2.1). grade_on_invariant: true hands the verdict to test_hand_back_names_its_owner (no MCP tool call at all, and a `Hand-back:` line); the judge is diagnostic.

input.delegation:
I just found Patrick Flynn's death certificate from 1908. Pull the key facts out of it and add them to the project.

projectPath: <workspace>

negative.explanation: The request is to extract facts from a found record. Extraction is `extraction_append` for a FamilySearch record and the record-structurer agent for any other source, not plan items. Since extraction became a tool call and an agent rather than a skill, no skill is the correct route, so this is an out-of-scope negative (`correct_skill: []`; genealogist ruling 2026-09-30, option B, landed in aa4ff9564). On the direct arm the agent's ROUTING section requires a hand-back before any tool call: test_hand_back_names_its_owner asserts zero MCP tool calls, so nothing can be written, and a `Hand-back:` line in the agent's return. That validator is the whole verdict.

judge_context: This is a hand-back test, graded on its invariant: the deterministic validator decides the outcome and these scores are diagnostic.
The correct action is a hand-back naming extraction (`extraction_append`, or the record-structurer agent), with no plan item written and no tool called.

The message gives no death certificate text, file or record id, so nothing can be extracted yet. Saying so while handing back is correct: do not lower Correctness or Completeness because no facts were extracted.
The two researcher-facing paragraphs after the final `---` must name no skill, agent, tool or field.
